replies.author: MushroomLanky4117
replies.body: ​I signed up for a cheap trial, but they quietly auto-renewed my subscription for $44.99 today without any clear warning. I realized it immediately, canceled the subscription on the exact same day, and didn't use a single credit for the new billing cycle. Despite zero usage, their support completely refused to refund my money and hid behind their terms and conditions. It's a classic subscription trap to steal your money.
